label: Restrict actual esse composition to a following PER_SE_5 link (inference)
rule: Restriction to a classified outgoing link and distinct actual incoming giver
meaning: Scope projection. From an actual incoming link retain the upstream giver's actuality and causal edge; from the per se outgoing link retain its actual causal edge with the other guards. The full law applies without any use of excluded middle or the caused-as-caused bridge. This direction registers the order of assumptions.
